subject: PoC direction and deployment-mode qualification for Fintegrate

Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Recommended PoC path and questions on deployment mode

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum:

Call highlights (very short):
- Primary constraints: data residency for EU users; SOC2 requirement for production; throughput target ~50 req/s for peak flows.
- Primary use-case: short-form transaction classification + customer-facing summarization.

Recommendation (to qualify):
1) Phase 1 (Dev validation, 2 weeks): Hosted API pilot using the same model family we demoed. Purpose: ensure prompt/quality and integrate end-to-end request/response flow.
2) Phase 2 (Performance & isolation, 3–4 weeks): Dedicated capacity trial to validate p95 latency and throughput under realistic load.
3) Phase 3 (Compliance gating, timeline dependent): Private VPC deployment only if the SOC2 scope or specific on-prem containment is required — this is heavier and we prefer to finalize after Phase 2.

Proposed PoC success criteria (please confirm):
- Quality: classification accuracy >= 92% on your eval set (we can host an eval harness).
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms for 512-token seqs on Dedicated.
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/s with <10% error budget for 1 hour sustained test.
- Integration: end-to-end calls from your staging environment with credentialed access.

Immediate asks from you:
1) Confirm the order above (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private) or tell us if you require Private earlier.
2) Share any compliance documents we should pre-read (you mentioned an RFI).
3) Identify internal stakeholders for security/network (name + email) so we can pull the right team in.

I've attached a short PoC checklist and a connectivity template to make the next steps easier (see attachments). If that sounds right, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff and loop in our solutions engineer to scope any network work.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Elena Park <elena.park@fintegrate.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Recommended PoC path and questions on deployment mode

Thanks, Dylan — this is helpful. A few clarifying points and constraints from our side:

- We do have EU-resident data flows we need to keep in-region; that will affect any Dedicated capacity placement (must be in eu-west).
- SOC2 is non-negotiable for prod; for the PoC we can run under an NDA but will need evidence (SOC2 audit report or equivalent controls) before production cutover.
- If Dedicated can be spun up in eu-west quickly, we prefer to do Hosted for dev + a parallel Dedicated performance validation (i.e., run Phases 1+2 in parallel) so we can shorten total calendar time.

Attached is our initial RFI (high level) — apologies it’s a messy export. Also want to confirm budget guardrails: we have a target upper bound for pilot spend of $40k USD. If Dedicated costs would exceed that, call it out.

Stakeholders:
- Security: Marcus Li (marcus.li@fintegrate.com)
- Platform lead (staging infra owner): Elena Park (elena.park@fintegrate.com)
- Procurement: TBD (I will loop them once we have pricing ballpark).

Can you send a proposed timeline with parallel-phase option and high-level cost guidance for Dedicated vs Private?

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Fintegrate
elena.park@fintegrate.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: Recommended PoC path and questions on deployment mode

Elena — thank you, and the RFI is useful. We can absolutely support the parallel-path approach (Hosted + Dedicated perf validation) to compress the timeline; Private only if SOC2 + additional controls require it before prod.

Proposed condensed timeline (parallel phases):
- Week 0: Kickoff and wiring (1 week) — sign simple PoC SOW, exchange network/connectivity info, and add HubSpot and drive links.
- Week 1–2: Hosted pilot (dev integration + quality tests) — our SDK + shared eval harness.
- Week 2–5: Dedicated perf run (eu-west pool) — load tests, latency profiling, KV/cache tuning.
- Week 5: Final review & decision (go/no-go for production).

High-level cost guidance (pilot estimates, non-binding):
- Hosted pilot: negligible — covered under evaluation credits (we'll allocate).
- Dedicated trial (reserved short-term pool in eu-west): estimated $25k–$35k for a 3–4 week trial depending on instance sizing and sustained throughput.
- Private VPC/on-prem: materially higher (onboarding + infra) — we can provide a scoping estimate once we know constraints; expect multi-month lead times if on-prem hardware is required.

Success criteria (we'll instrument these):
- Quality: >=92% on your evaluation set (we will run evals and share per-class breakdown).
- Latency: p95 <=200ms on Dedicated at target load.
- Throughput: 50 req/s sustained for 1 hour with <10% errors.
- Compliance readout: SOC2 evidence delivered to your security team prior to prod.

Next steps I can action today if you confirm:
- Send a 30-min kickoff invite for Wed or Thu next week.
- Share the procurement contact so we can propose the short PoC SOW and a non-binding pricing deck.
- We'll provision an eu-west Dedicated pool hold (no charge for 72 hours) to lock availability while procurement completes.

Link to PoC checklist and shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPoC-Fintegrate
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/FIN-2026-0042

I'll wait for your availability and procurement point of contact.

Thanks —
